interface.name: zxdg_daxos_acrylic_manager_v1

description.summary: manages acrylic blur effects for wayland surfaces

interface.description: Global interface exposed by drex-compositor to bind real-time acrylic frosted glass blur effects to application surfaces without screen-tearing.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager object. Existing acrylic surface objects remain active.

request.name: get_acrylic_surface

description.summary: create an acrylic blur handle for a surface

request.description: Creates a zxdg_daxos_acrylic_surface_v1 object associated with the specified wl_surface.

interface.name: zxdg_daxos_acrylic_surface_v1

description.summary: acrylic blur interface for a specific surface

interface.description: Allows setting parameters such as opacity, blur radius, edge brightness, and noise.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: acrylic surface already bound to wl_surface

request.name: destroy

description.summary: remove acrylic blur effect from surface

request.description: Destroys the acrylic effect object and restores standard compositing for the wl_surface.

request.name: set_blur_radius

description.summary: set gaussian/kawase blur radius in pixels

request.description: Specifies the blur radius in physical pixels [0 .. 128].

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: Specifies surface opacity in fixed-point format (wl_fixed_t) between 0.05 and 1.0.

request.name: set_edge_brightness
request.description: Specifies edge highlight multiplier in fixed-point [0.0 .. 2.0].

request.name: set_noise_intensity

description.summary: set procedural acrylic grain texture intensity

request.description: Specifies noise grain intensity in fixed-point [0.0 .. 1.0].

request.name: commit
request.description: Atomically commits blur parameters to the compositor frame graph.

event.name: parameters_applied

description.summary: notifies client that parameters took effect on screen

event.description: Sent by the compositor after the new acrylic parameters are rendered.
